now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#36
now.text: When Mojo comes to Earth to stage a televised hunt of the X-Men, Jubilee fights him beside Longshot.

proposed.text: When Mojo comes to Earth to stage a televised hunt of the X-Men, he captures Jubilee, and the X-Men fight through his show to rescue her.

changes.evidence: In 'Longshot' (X-Men: The Animated Series #36), Jubilee fights off Mojo's henchmen with Longshot early on, but when Mojo himself arrives on Earth he ambushes and captures her (disguised as a scarecrow) and the X-Men must fight through his show to save her. She does not fight Mojo beside Longshot; the card lines ('Traps Jubilee') already reflect this.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#68
now.text: Sinister saves Beast from the Phalanx and helps him build the virus that destroys it.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An unlikely ally. Saves Beast from the Phalanx.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Saved from the Phalanx by Sinister.

proposed.text: Sinister works with Beast, Forge and Warlock on Muir Island to make the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An unlikely ally. Helps Beast make the virus that destroys the Phalanx.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Makes the virus against the Phalanx with Sinister.

changes.evidence: Sinister's rescue of Beast (and Forge) from the Phalanx, escaping on his ship, happens in The Phalanx Covenant Part 1 (#67), already covered by stage 0. In Part 2 (#68) the group goes to Muir Island and makes the virus; no rescue of Beast by Sinister happens in that episode.
